_about: Personality building blocks. Traits are grouped light/dark/neutral/exotic; each has a short gloss. Strength is rolled by the engine (mild, strong, obsessive). Original content written for DCUGen.

light.name: Steadfast
light.gloss: keeps promises even when it costs

light.name: Protective
light.gloss: steps between the weak and whatever threatens them

light.name: Generous
light.gloss: gives time and money without keeping score

light.name: Hopeful
light.gloss: believes tomorrow can be better, despite evidence

light.name: Patient
light.gloss: waits out tempers, sieges and slow answers

light.name: Honest
light.gloss: would rather hurt with the truth than soothe with a lie

light.name: Forgiving
light.gloss: lets grudges go, sometimes too easily

light.name: Brave
light.gloss: acts while afraid instead of waiting for the fear to pass

light.name: Compassionate
light.gloss: feels other people's pain as if it were their own

light.name: Loyal
light.gloss: stands by friends long after it stops being smart

light.name: Humble
light.gloss: deflects praise and credits the team

light.name: Fair-minded
light.gloss: hears both sides before judging

light.name: Diligent
light.gloss: finishes what is started, every time

light.name: Cheerful
light.gloss: lightens dark rooms with jokes and warmth

light.name: Curious
light.gloss: wants to know how everything and everyone works

light.name: Gentle
light.gloss: uses the least force that will do the job

light.name: Respectful
light.gloss: treats janitors and senators exactly the same

light.name: Self-sacrificing
light.gloss: puts others first, even at real personal cost

light.name: Dependable
light.gloss: shows up on time, with what was promised

light.name: Encouraging
light.gloss: sees potential in people and says so out loud

light.name: Principled
light.gloss: has lines that are never crossed

light.name: Grateful
light.gloss: remembers every kindness ever received

light.name: Calm under fire
light.gloss: gets quieter and clearer as things get worse

light.name: Idealistic
light.gloss: still believes in justice with a capital J

light.name: Merciful
light.gloss: offers second chances, even to enemies

light.name: Resourceful
light.gloss: makes something useful out of whatever is at hand

light.name: Polite
light.gloss: says please and thank you, even to henchmen

light.name: Nurturing
light.gloss: feeds people, checks on people, worries about people

light.name: Tolerant
light.gloss: gives strangers and their strange ways the benefit of the doubt

light.name: Responsible
light.gloss: owns mistakes without excuses

light.name: Witty
light.gloss: quick with a line that defuses tension

light.name: Devout
light.gloss: draws strength from a living faith

light.name: Inspiring
light.gloss: makes others want to be better just by example

light.name: Modest
light.gloss: uncomfortable in the spotlight, happiest in the background

light.name: Trusting
light.gloss: assumes the best of people until proven otherwise

light.name: Thrifty
light.gloss: wastes nothing and shares the savings

dark.name: Vengeful
dark.gloss: never lets a wrong go unanswered

dark.name: Arrogant
dark.gloss: assumes {they_are} the smartest person in the room

dark.name: Greedy
dark.gloss: always wants a bigger cut

dark.name: Cynical
dark.gloss: assumes everyone has an angle

dark.name: Cruel
dark.gloss: enjoys other people's discomfort a little too much

dark.name: Jealous
dark.gloss: resents anyone who has what {they_are} missing

dark.name: Hot-tempered
dark.gloss: goes from calm to fists in seconds

dark.name: Deceitful
dark.gloss: lies by reflex, even when the truth would do

dark.name: Cowardly
dark.gloss: runs first and rationalizes later

dark.name: Callous
dark.gloss: shrugs off other people's suffering

dark.name: Manipulative
dark.gloss: pulls strings and calls it helping

dark.name: Paranoid
dark.gloss: sees conspiracies everywhere, sometimes correctly

dark.name: Reckless
dark.gloss: takes risks with other people's safety

dark.name: Selfish
dark.gloss: asks what's in it for {them} before anything else

dark.name: Spiteful
dark.gloss: would rather lose than let a rival win

dark.name: Lazy
dark.gloss: finds the shortcut, even when it's a cliff

dark.name: Vain
dark.gloss: obsessed with appearance and reputation

dark.name: Bigoted
dark.gloss: has ugly ideas about some group of people

dark.name: Domineering
dark.gloss: needs to be in charge of every room

dark.name: Self-pitying
dark.gloss: treats every setback as proof the world is unfair

dark.name: Cold
dark.gloss: keeps everyone at arm's length

dark.name: Ruthless
dark.gloss: accepts any cost to get results

dark.name: Petty
dark.gloss: keeps score of every small slight

dark.name: Bitter
dark.gloss: chews on old injuries until they define {them}

dark.name: Sullen
dark.gloss: broods silently and makes everyone feel it

dark.name: Boastful
dark.gloss: turns every story into a story about {them}

dark.name: Untrustworthy
dark.gloss: breaks promises when it's convenient

dark.name: Contemptuous
dark.gloss: looks down on 'ordinary' people

dark.name: Impatient
dark.gloss: can't stand waiting, explaining or listening

dark.name: Hypocritical
dark.gloss: holds others to rules {they_are} happy to break

dark.name: Sadistic streak
dark.gloss: likes having power over someone who's afraid

dark.name: Thrill-addicted
dark.gloss: needs danger to feel awake, and drags others into it

dark.name: Distrustful
dark.gloss: refuses help, even when drowning

dark.name: Stubborn
dark.gloss: would rather be wrong than change course

dark.name: Grudging
dark.gloss: helps, but makes sure everyone knows the cost

dark.name: Obsessive control
dark.gloss: micromanages everything and everyone

neutral.name: Reserved
neutral.gloss: speaks only when it matters

neutral.name: Talkative
neutral.gloss: narrates everything, including fights

neutral.name: Pragmatic
neutral.gloss: cares about what works, not what's pretty

neutral.name: Competitive
neutral.gloss: turns everything into a contest

neutral.name: Ambitious
neutral.gloss: always looking at the next rung

neutral.name: Skeptical
neutral.gloss: wants evidence before belief

neutral.name: Romantic
neutral.gloss: falls fast and hard

neutral.name: Spontaneous
neutral.gloss: plans are suggestions

neutral.name: Methodical
neutral.gloss: lists, checklists and lists of checklists

neutral.name: Nostalgic
neutral.gloss: lives partly in the good old days

neutral.name: Sarcastic
neutral.gloss: says the opposite of what {they_are} thinking, loudly

neutral.name: Restless
neutral.gloss: can't sit still, can't stay put

neutral.name: Private
neutral.gloss: shares nothing personal without a good reason

neutral.name: Blunt
neutral.gloss: skips the small talk and the cushioning

neutral.name: Dreamy
neutral.gloss: often somewhere else inside {their} head

neutral.name: Frugal
neutral.gloss: reuses tea bags and haggles at yard sales

neutral.name: Flamboyant
neutral.gloss: dresses loud, talks loud, lives loud

neutral.name: Analytical
neutral.gloss: turns feelings into problems to solve

neutral.name: Traditional
neutral.gloss: trusts the old ways

neutral.name: Rebellious
neutral.gloss: pushes back on any rule, on principle

neutral.name: Easygoing
neutral.gloss: rarely rattled, rarely in a hurry

neutral.name: Intense
neutral.gloss: gives everything 110 percent, including breakfast

neutral.name: Superstitious
neutral.gloss: knocks on wood, avoids ladders, respects omens

neutral.name: Workaholic
neutral.gloss: the job is the life

neutral.name: Introverted
neutral.gloss: recharges alone and dreads parties

neutral.name: Gregarious
neutral.gloss: makes friends in elevators

neutral.name: Perfectionist
neutral.gloss: nothing is ever quite finished

neutral.name: Literal-minded
neutral.gloss: misses sarcasm and hints

neutral.name: Daredevil
neutral.gloss: loves speed, heights and dares

neutral.name: Moody
neutral.gloss: weather changes inside {them} by the hour

neutral.name: Sentimental
neutral.gloss: keeps ticket stubs and cries at commercials

neutral.name: Opinionated
neutral.gloss: has a take on everything, and shares it

neutral.name: Absent-minded
neutral.gloss: loses keys, names and track of time

neutral.name: Thrill-seeker
neutral.gloss: chases adrenaline on weekends

neutral.name: Formal
neutral.gloss: uses full names and proper titles

neutral.name: Night owl
neutral.gloss: most alive after midnight

exotic.name: Counts everything
exotic.gloss: steps, windows, bullets left in a magazine

exotic.name: Talks to machines
exotic.gloss: pleads with, praises and scolds them by name

exotic.name: Collects keys
exotic.gloss: has hundreds, for locks long gone

exotic.name: Hears music in silence
exotic.gloss: hums along to something nobody else hears

exotic.name: Refuses to say a certain word
exotic.gloss: and goes to great lengths to avoid it

exotic.name: Ritual before danger
exotic.gloss: always ties the left shoe first, touches a lucky charm, says a phrase

exotic.name: Speaks in third person when stressed
exotic.gloss: '{name} does not like this'

exotic.name: Precognitive hunches
exotic.gloss: gets feelings that are right a bit too often

exotic.name: Collects villains' calling cards
exotic.gloss: keeps a scrapbook of them

exotic.name: Never sleeps in a bed
exotic.gloss: couches, chairs, rooftops

exotic.name: Remembers every face
exotic.gloss: and is unsettled by the ones that reappear

exotic.name: Compulsive honesty
exotic.gloss: physically cannot tell even a white lie

exotic.name: Fascinated by fire
exotic.gloss: stares at flames a little too long

exotic.name: Feels watched
exotic.gloss: always sits facing the door

exotic.name: Taste synesthesia
exotic.gloss: names and voices have flavors

exotic.name: Lucky streaks
exotic.gloss: wins coin tosses with eerie regularity

exotic.name: Narrates life like a noir novel
exotic.gloss: out loud, sometimes

exotic.name: Hoards supplies
exotic.gloss: canned goods, batteries, first-aid kits

exotic.name: Sleepwalks
exotic.gloss: and occasionally wakes up somewhere unexpected

exotic.name: Animals adore {them}
exotic.gloss: strays follow {them} home unbidden

exotic.name: Clock-perfect
exotic.gloss: always knows the exact time without looking

exotic.name: Dreams of other lives
exotic.gloss: vivid, consistent and detailed

exotic.name: Can't stand being touched
exotic.gloss: flinches from handshakes

exotic.name: Needs to finish a meal
exotic.gloss: even in the middle of an emergency

exotic.name: Keeps a list of everyone who wronged {them}
exotic.gloss: in a small black notebook

exotic.name: Mirrors accents
exotic.gloss: picks up anyone's accent within minutes

exotic.name: Cannot whistle
exotic.gloss: and is weirdly sensitive about it

exotic.name: Draws maps of everywhere
exotic.gloss: including rooms visited only once

exotic.name: Avoids mirrors
exotic.gloss: and won't say why

exotic.name: Talks to the dead
exotic.gloss: out loud, at graves, conversationally

Order and the rule of law
Personal honor and keeping one's word

voices: Low and slow; every word sounds considered.
Fast-talking, with a dozen half-finished sentences in the air at once.
A thick accent from {hometown} that gets thicker when angry.
Soft-spoken; people lean in to hear.
Booming laugh, booming voice, booming everything.
Dry and deadpan; jokes land a beat late.
Formal and precise, like reading from a report.
Peppers speech with old-fashioned slang.
Swears creatively and constantly.
Never swears; uses absurd substitutes instead.
Answers questions with questions.
Speaks in short, clipped sentences. No wasted words.
Gentle, patient, teacher-like.
Sarcastic, with a running commentary on everything.
Warm, folksy and full of homespun sayings.
Switches between two languages mid-sentence.
Quotes song lyrics and movie lines to make a point.
Talks to everyone like an old friend.
Mumbles, then says the important part very clearly.
Polished, persuasive, salesperson-smooth.
Military cadence; calls people by last names.
Nervous chatter that fills every silence.
Calls people by nicknames they never agreed to.
Speaks in a hoarse rasp from an old injury.
Uses big words slightly wrong, with total confidence.
Laughs at the wrong moments when tense.
Narrates {their} own actions under {their} breath.
Says 'listen' before every important sentence.
Calm, clinical, like a doctor delivering news.
Theatrical; every sentence is a performance.
Speaks very little, but writes long, thoughtful messages.
Folksy metaphors about farming, fishing or baseball.
Precise about numbers: 'Forty-three seconds, not a minute.'
Ends sentences with 'yeah?' or 'right?'

Has a pet phrase for every situation and uses it to death.
